transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for being here. This is our final-rundown meeting before we lock the show. As you know, the opening segment runs 90 seconds before our first presenter comes out. The current draft has us using the lift-based stage entrance, 'Neon Hearts' as the song, and Maya Chen as our sole host. We also have a floor-based choreography alternative and 'Afterglow' as a cleared backup in the working rundown. Before I make my binding approval on the opening, I need to go around the room: choreography, music, and talent operations — each of you, please report any item that must be reflected before we lock this rundown. I won't approve until I've heard from all three of you.

transcript.text: I need to flag a safety issue before we lock anything. My post-rehearsal load check found that the planned lift entrance would place 950 pounds on a stage point certified for only 800 pounds. The floor-based choreography alternative is approved for 12 dancers and would avoid this overload. I'm still waiting for the venue engineer's written report before sending the issue to the production office, but I need this on the record now — the lift entrance as currently drafted is not safe to approve.
